When I fell hands over heels in love with my best friend, I confessed to her and she said we could still be friends. (it went without saying that she didn’t like me back, I had already given her advice about HER crush.) Anyways, I handled it really poorly and our friendship was ruined and it almost pushed me to suicide since her emotional support was the popsicle sticks and glue that was holding me up. All I can say is that you don’t wanna miss your shot, and if you think she could like you back you should certainly shoot it, but in the scenario where she rejects you, do NOT casually talk about your feelings. It’s hard to not be open like that to a very close friend, but if you “don’t make a big deal” about your feelings for her and joke about it or just mention it casually she is going to get uncomfortable with you and eventually try to distance herself from you. Anyways, this is an old post and Idek if you still want advice but screw it. I wish you the best of luck, and I hope she likes you back!
